title: Skill ios-apps and degen shared-sim-lease say every session leases a phone sim, while the "Boot path" bullet says reuse takes no lease: make them agree
why: Two bullets of one skill give different answers for a reused booted simulator, so a session cannot tell whether to lease.
source: Batch runner 11 read, 14:40 CST Nov 13, for owner item 737 (confirm-31-pick-rulings).
note: Filed 14:37 CST Nov 13. Runner 11's read (unread by triage): bin/sim-test header lines 8-9 "Reuse takes no lease and shuts nothing down"; skill ios-apps "Sharing the Mac", bullet "Boot path": "The reuse path takes no lease"; the same skill's "Leased simulators" bullet and degen shared-sim-lease say every session leases a phone sim through bin/sim-lease. Fix: one sentence in the "Leased simulators" bullet and in shared-sim-lease naming the reuse exception, so main's reading (reuse takes no lease) is the only one. Owner has not ruled on item 737's sim-lease conflict; this step is a wording fix that matches main either way. Past rulings not checked.
